title: Engage the winger
brief: Their #6 is looking for a long switch, maybe to your side.
briefKid: Their midfielder wants to kick a long pass, maybe to your side.
question: Their winger is holding the ball up on your side. Where should you be?
questionKid: Their winger has the ball near you. Where do you go?

takeaway.standard: When the ball reaches the winger on your side, go out and engage them before they can turn: goal-side and a little inside, so they can only go down the line, while a teammate covers behind you.
takeaway.kid: Their winger has the ball near you? Get close, between them and our goal.

misconceptions.text: You stayed tucked in, which gives their winger all the time they want to turn and run at your back line.
misconceptions.textKid: Their winger has lots of time. Go and get close to them.

misconceptions.text: You went round the outside of them, which opens the way inside toward our goal; engage from the inside.
misconceptions.textKid: Stand on their inside, so they can only go down the line.
